principles: Whole-pixel actor motion and nearest-neighbor frames
State changes are immediate; presentation recovery never blocks manual control
Ambient beats use offset phases and stay behind decision-critical silhouettes
The fixed camera never cuts or shakes

stateGraphs.courier: idle/walk four-direction -> talk/interact -> carry -> gust-brace or shelter-check -> handoff -> follow-up walk/select
stateGraphs.bottle: absent -> rise -> carried W1/S2 -> W2/S1|preserved -> handoff -> consumed
stateGraphs.interface: opening -> request -> feedback -> carried -> comparison -> follow-up

interruptions.manualInput: Never locked; a later real action may replace the active presentation beat.
interruptions.factoryReplay: Holds zero input for the authored 1.15 s reaction read, then resumes the same direct-axis plan.
interruptions.repeatedIngredient: A new add restarts the local arc from the newly selected ingredient without duplicating persistent effects.
interruptions.fallback: Authoritative potion, route, reaction, and follow-up state remains visible even after an animation has settled.

ambientContinuity.wind: Two translucent ribbon instances with different phase and opacity
ambientContinuity.pennants: Independent 3.5/4.0 Hz sway only after follow-up activation

transitions.disclosure: Opening withdraws only after partner gesture begins.
transitions.bottle: The bottle rises physically before the carried panel becomes visible.
transitions.reaction: Handoff precedes relief/shiver; pose precedes label and comparison.
transitions.followup: Reaction settles before pennants, info signs, and E GO become eligible.

providerProvenance.method: Hand-authored direct raster frames plus engine-native state choreography

regressionChecks.repeatedLoopSeams: Ambient sheets loop on fixed frame cadences with stable pivots and palette.
regressionChecks.reducedMotion: Not required by the slice contract; authoritative state and labels remain readable with effects settled or absent.
regressionChecks.performance: Both 900-tick real-renderer scenarios completed with 150 PNG samples and zero scenario violations.
